versao: 3 — expressões editoriais sérias; correção anatômica da mão em Farol
tipo: edição das cinco fotografias com pessoas em uso no site
observacao: As imagens de entrada eram as versões anteriores de cada arquivo público; os manifests de campanha e inspirações preservam as gerações anteriores. A segunda referência de cada edição era somente a luminária do catálogo.

prompt.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Edit FIRST image, the current Per Parte Farol campaign, as a very controlled photographic retouch. SECOND image is reference ONLY for exact Farol product geometry and colors. Preserve the same fictional young auburn-wavy-haired woman with freckles, distinctive yellow oversized puff-sleeved blouse, cobalt trousers with big cream circles and coral boots, same setting, position, framing and natural skin. Make her expression serious and poised like a fashion model in a high-end design editorial: mouth relaxed fully closed, no smile, no raised playful eyebrow, calm assertive eyes directed toward the camera, subtly sculpted cheek and jaw without changing identity. Correct the visually unnatural hand pose next to her face: remove the chin-resting hand from that side of her cheek. Repose that hand and its entire forearm so it rests casually on the near edge of the teal tiled plinth in front of her torso, with a clearly visible continuous elbow/forearm connecting to the correct yellow sleeve and shoulder. Her other arm alone stays raised toward the silver floating sphere on viewer-right, connected anatomically to the opposite shoulder. Exactly two arms and two hands, realistic five fingers per hand, no arm/hand crossing behind or through the face, no duplicate limbs. Her head is free of hand contact, held upright in an intentional serious editorial pose. Keep Farol lamp completely unchanged at exact position and scale: ivory illuminated vertically ribbed capsule, teal collar and short broad teal base, unobscured on tiled pedestal. Keep silver orb, hanging checked sphere, folded cream arches, blue/teal backdrop, tiles, floor, shadows, lighting and large empty left area identical. Landscape composition 1536x1024. No new objects, no text, logo or watermark. Change only facial expression and the awkward chin-hand/forearm pose; do not move the product or recomposite the scene.
